title: Why Choose Whiteboard Consultants for Your Malta Journey?
description: From Kolkata to Malta, we help you move from confusion to clarity with personalised, honest and structured guidance.

features.text: Malta-specific guidance using up-to-date knowledge of education, visa rules and the job market.
End-to-end support from shortlisting universities and reviewing SOPs to structuring funds and pre-departure planning.
Transparent budgeting so you build realistic first-year and monthly cost plans.
Career-focused counselling connecting courses to Malta's real sectors — hospitality, iGaming, fintech and shared services.
India-aware documentation expertise for mark sheets, backlogs, education loans and family funding patterns.
Personalised guidance on course selection, visa filing and post-study work pathways.
